notes.title: Lemon vs. Teddy Update v.1.1.0
notes.notes:
This update adds a new playable character as well as makes the boss fights quicker and less frustrating. It also includes a few minor changes.

A new playable character - Laura joins Rai and Ufola in the BBBB jungle. For those few of you who actually are interested in playing the game (instead of just going for the achievement), you can make her join your party and try out her completely new abilities!
Meditation is now a separate choice during combat instead of being an ability (finally...)
Bosses have now less health overall. A few of them have also gained new attacks or have been completely reworked.
A few new abilities for Zitrone (2 new abilities) and Noemi (1 new ability)
Quality of life changes - you can now press Shift during combat to switch the current character. Some combat animations have been slightly sped up as well.
Other minor changes - some graphical improvements, a few new music tracks, slight screenshake whenever you damage an enemy, very experimental controller support (using a keyboard is still recommended as it probably won't work with all controllers)

notes.title: Lemon vs. Teddy Update v.1.0.1
notes.notes:
This minor update fixes the most commonly reported issues.

 The spell and item selection menus in battle now remember the last choice
 EXP and BTC drop has been increased by 15%
 Zitrone and Noemi now start with 1 more ability (Chill and Virus, respectively)
 Teddy's Yellow doom ability is now available upon reaching level 10 instead of 12
 Rabbit is now slightly weaker
